name: WeVisOne-VL 2B / 4B

lineage.how_derived: adds coordinate tokens and a 9.6M-parameter pixel decoder (mask_decoder.pt)

purpose: Unified visual perception from objects to pixels: open-vocabulary detection, referring localization, counting, pointing, OCR localization, referring segmentation and alpha matting through structured next-token prediction (card). Intended for research.

license.name: Apache-2.0 (Tencent code); third-party components keep their licenses
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0 and a License section saying Tencent-authored code is Apache-2.0; the weights' terms are not stated separately and no LICENSE text was opened.

architecture.kind: dense vision-language transformer (Qwen3-VL 4B: 36 layers, hidden 2560) plus pixel decoder with deformable cross-attention

pc-12gb.notes: 9.7 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 9.7 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 9.7 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 9.7 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: the mask decoder is a custom component, so plain llama.cpp would only give the text/box part

tona_fit.reason: A perception model for detection, segmentation and matting, not a document or coding model; only of interest if Tona later gets image-grounding tools. Single-turn only.
